name: AgenticCore
description: A done-for-you agency where AI agents plan, build and run the work: custom websites, branding, marketing, bookkeeping and reports, plus feasibility and audits. Also builds custom AI agent frameworks to a client's own strategy — the client owns the strategy, AgenticCore builds the system. Packages bundle a landing site, social content, branded documents and a feasibility + marketing report from $150. Its marketing arm (agenticcore.biz) specialises in complete campaigns for real estate developers. Everything is fixed-price and quoted before any payment.
audience: Real estate developers, agents and brokerages who need marketing and systems built for them, plus founders launching a business from scratch with no setup yet. Global, weighted to markets with the most demand — India, Pakistan and the Gulf.
goal: Get the right people to the signup page, or into the Telegram/WhatsApp chat
tone: plain, concrete, no hype. Explains the mechanism rather than selling the outcome. Confident without claiming credentials it does not have.
forbidden_claims: any guaranteed result, ranking, lead volume or return
named clients, case studies, testimonials or years in business — there are none yet
any statistic about AgenticCore's own performance
claiming to be an established or award-winning agency
